lines.en: My nights with you,
you shine like the sun beside me,
without you I would not sing,
without you I would not live.
If you have a heart, understand me,
take me like a flower and plant me,

lines.cyr: вечно да цветам јас за тебе,
lines.lat: večno da cvetam jas za tebe,
lines.en: so I may bloom forever for you,

lines.cyr: а ти да стоиш крај мене.
lines.lat: a ti da stoiš kraj mene.
lines.en: and you stand beside me.
Do not regret sleepless nights,
do not count white days,
nights are for kissing,
days are cold thoughts.
If you have a heart, understand me,
take me like a flower and plant me,

In the morning you drink coffee,
soon you leave,
for you the coffee is honeyed,
for me the coffee is poison.
If you have a heart, understand me,
take me like a flower and plant me,
